units.locator: Article 20. Citizens’ meeting
units.text: 13. Decisions adopted at a citizens’ meeting apply only to residents of the relevant territories, are advisory and are implemented by residents voluntarily.
units.label: Point 13 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Citizens’ meeting
units.text: 14. The procedure for holding a citizens’ meeting is determined by a decision of the City Duma and the charter of territorial public self-government, in accordance with Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’ and this Charter.
units.label: Point 14 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Citizens’ meeting
units.text: 15. Appeals adopted by a citizens’ meeting must be considered by the local self-government bodies and officials competent to resolve the matters raised in them, with a written response being sent.
units.label: Point 15 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Citizens’ meeting
units.text: 16. The outcomes of a citizens’ meeting are subject to official publication (promulgation).
units.label: Point 16 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 21. Citizens’ conference (meeting of delegates)
units.text: Article 21. Citizens’ conference (meeting of delegates)
units.label: Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Citizens’ conference (meeting of delegates)
units.text: 1. In cases provided for by decisions of the City Duma or the charter of territorial public self-government, the powers of a citizens’ meeting may be exercised by a citizens’ conference (meeting of delegates).
units.label: Point 1 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Citizens’ conference (meeting of delegates)
units.text: 2. The procedure for calling and holding a citizens’ conference (meeting of delegates) and electing its delegates is determined by decisions of the City Duma and the charter of territorial public self-government.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Citizens’ conference (meeting of delegates)
units.text: 3. The outcomes of a citizens’ conference (meeting of delegates) are subject to official publication (promulgation).
units.label: Point 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 22. Citizens’ survey
units.text: Article 22. Citizens’ survey
units.label: Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Citizens’ survey
units.text: 1. A citizens’ survey is conducted throughout or in part of the municipality’s territory to ascertain the population’s opinion and take it into account in decisions by the City Duma, the Head of Yekaterinburg and state authorities.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Citizens’ survey
units.text: The survey results are advisory.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 22 · “The survey results are advisory.”

units.locator: Article 22. Citizens’ survey
units.text: 2. Residents of the municipality who have voting rights may participate in a citizens’ survey.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Citizens’ survey
units.text: Residents of the municipality or the part of it in which an initiative project is proposed to be implemented who have reached sixteen years of age may participate in a citizens’ survey to ascertain opinions on support for that project.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 22 · “Residents of the municipality or the part of it in which an…”

units.locator: Article 22. Citizens’ survey
units.text: 3. The procedure for calling and conducting a citizens’ survey is determined by a decision of the City Duma in accordance with a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Citizens’ survey
units.text: 4. The decision to call a citizens’ survey is adopted by the City Duma.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Citizens’ survey
units.text: 5. Residents of the municipality must be informed of a citizens’ survey at least 10 days before it is conducted.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Citizens’ survey
units.text: 6. Measures connected with preparing and conducting a citizens’ survey are financed in accordance with federal legislation.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.label: Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 1. Citizens have the right to submit individual and collective appeals to local self-government bodies
units.label: Point 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 2. Citizens’ appeals are considered in accordance with the procedure and time limits established by Federal Law of 2 May 2006 No. 59-ФЗ ‘On the Procedure for Considering Appeals from Citizens of the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 3. Local self-government officials bear the liability established by legislation for breaches of the procedure or time limits for considering citizens’ appeals.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: Article 23-1. Civic Chamber of the municipality
units.label: Point 3 Art. 23 · “Article 23-1. Civic Chamber of the municipality”

units.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 1. The Civic Chamber of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” (hereinafter referred to as the Civic Chamber) discusses a broad range of socially significant issues and submits proposals for resolving them to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 2. The Civic Chamber operates on a non-permanent basis and is not a local self-government body.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: Decisions of the Civic Chamber are advisory.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 23 · “Decisions of the Civic Chamber are advisory.”

units.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 3. The Civic Chamber is formed from residents of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” who have their permanent residence in that municipality and have reached eighteen years of age.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 4. Members of the Civic Chamber exercise their powers without release from their principal work and without remuneration.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Citizens’ appeals to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 5. The formation procedure, number of members, status and operating procedures of the Civic Chamber are governed by regulations approved by the City Duma.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 23

units.locator: Chapter IV. BODIES AND OFFICIALS OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT
units.text: Chapter IV. BODIES AND OFFICIALS OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT
units.label: Chapter IV. BODIES AND OFFICIALS OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT

units.locator: Chapter IV. BODIES AND OFFICIALS OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT
units.text: OF THE MUNICIPALITY “CITY OF YEKATERINBURG”
units.label: Chapter IV. BODIES AND OFFICIALS OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT · “OF THE MUNICIPALITY “CITY OF YEKATERINBURG””

units.locator: Article 24. Structure of local self-government bodies
units.text: Article 24. Structure of local self-government bodies
units.label: Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Structure of local self-government bodies
units.text: 1. The structure of local self-government bodies comprises the City Duma, the Head of Yekaterinburg, the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg and the Chamber of Accounts.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Structure of local self-government bodies
units.text: 2. The formation procedure, powers, term of office, accountability and subjection to oversight of local self-government bodies, and other matters concerning their organization and activities, are determined by this Charter.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Structure of local self-government bodies
units.text: 3. The municipality’s local self-government bodies do not form part of the system of state authorities.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Structure of local self-government bodies
units.text: 4. The structure of the municipality’s local self-government bodies may be changed only by amending and supplementing this Charter.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Structure of local self-government bodies
units.text: 5. A City Duma decision changing the structure of local self-government bodies enters into force no earlier than the expiry of the term of the City Duma that adopted it, except in cases provided for by Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Structure of local self-government bodies
units.text: 6. The activities of local self-government bodies are financed exclusively from the municipal budget’s own revenue.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Structure of local self-government bodies
units.text: 7. Local self-government bodies act in accordance with their own powers to address matters of local significance established by federal and oblast legislation and this Charter. They may not take up matters assigned to the jurisdiction of other local self-government bodies.
units.label: Point 7 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 25. City Duma
units.text: Article 25. City Duma
units.label: Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. City Duma
units.text: 1. The City Duma is the representative body of the municipality, vested with its own powers to address matters of local significance. The term of the City Duma is 5 years.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. City Duma
units.text: 2. The City Duma has 35 deputies.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. City Duma
units.text: 2-1. 25 City Duma deputies are elected in single-member constituencies formed within the municipality’s territory, and 10 deputies are elected in a single constituency covering the municipality’s entire territory, in proportion to the number of votes received by each candidate list nominated by electoral associations.
units.label: Point 2-1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. City Duma
units.text: 3. City Duma deputies are elected for 5 years in municipal elections on the basis of universal, equal and direct suffrage by secret ballot, in accordance with federal and oblast electoral legislation and this Charter.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. City Duma
units.text: 4. The City Duma may exercise its powers after at least two thirds of the prescribed number of deputies have been elected.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. City Duma
units.text: 5. Meetings are the principal organizational form of the City Duma’s activities. Its first meeting is held no later than two weeks after at least two thirds of the prescribed number of deputies have been elected. A City Duma meeting cannot have a quorum if fewer than fifty percent of the elected deputies are present.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. City Duma
units.text: Matters within the City Duma’s jurisdiction are decided at its meetings. The frequency of meetings and the procedure for convening and holding them are established by the City Duma’s Rules of Procedure.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 25 · “Matters within the City Duma’s jurisdiction are decided at its…”

units.locator: Article 25. City Duma
units.text: 6. Within its powers, the City Duma adopts decisions establishing rules binding throughout the municipality’s territory and decisions concerning the organization of the City Duma’s activities.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. City Duma
units.text: 7. The City Duma adopts Rules of Procedure governing the organization of its activities and the procedure for adopting decisions.
units.label: Point 7 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. City Duma
units.text: 8. The City Duma has the rights of a legal entity.
units.label: Point 8 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. City Duma
units.text: 9. Expenditure to support the City Duma’s activities is provided for as a separate line in the municipal budget in accordance with the budget expenditure classification of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 9 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.label: Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 1. The City Duma’s exclusive powers include:
units.label: Point 1 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 1) adopting the Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” and amending and supplementing it;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 1 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 1-1) adopting a decision to dismiss the Head of Yekaterinburg from office;
units.label: Subpoint 1-1 Point 1 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 2) approving the municipal budget and the report on its execution on the proposal of the Head of Yekaterinburg;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 1 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 3) introducing, amending and abolishing local taxes and levies on the proposal of the Head of Yekaterinburg, and establishing relief from those taxes and levies;
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 1 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 4) approving the municipality’s socioeconomic development strategy;
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 1 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 4-1) approving rules for improvement of the municipality’s territory;
units.label: Subpoint 4-1 Point 1 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 5) determining the procedure for managing and disposing of municipally owned property on the proposal of the Head of Yekaterinburg;
units.label: Subpoint 5 Point 1 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 6) determining, on the proposal of the Head of Yekaterinburg, the procedure for adopting decisions to establish, reorganize or liquidate municipal enterprises and to set tariffs for municipal enterprises’ and institutions’ services and the performance of work, except in cases provided for by federal laws;
units.label: Subpoint 6 Point 1 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 7) determining the procedure for the municipality’s participation in intermunicipal cooperation organizations;
units.label: Subpoint 7 Point 1 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 8) determining the procedure for providing material, technical and organizational support for the activities of the municipality’s local self-government bodies;
units.label: Subpoint 8 Point 1 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 9) overseeing the exercise by local self-government bodies and officials of powers to address matters of local significance.
units.label: Subpoint 9 Point 1 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 2. The City Duma’s jurisdiction also includes:
units.label: Point 2 Art. 26
